Settings.title: Setting

strength.label: Strength
strength.rule: Fixed values 0 to 5; meanings do not change.

beverageStyle.label: Beverage Style
beverageStyle.rule: Values in use can only be deactivated.

unit.label: Unit
unit.rule: g and ml only; not free text.

materialType.label: Material Type
materialType.rule: Values in use can only be deactivated.

currency.label: Currency
currency.rule: Only MYR at launch. More currencies may be added later; there is no currency conversion.

language.label: Language
language.rule: English and Simplified Chinese enabled. Malay later.

Invite.title: Activate your account

Invite.fullNameHint: As shown on your IC or passport, in capital letters.

RawMaterials.title: Raw Material
RawMaterials.intro: Shared purchased materials and packaging. Prices count toward drink cost only after Admin approval.
RawMaterials.noAccess: Only Managers and Admins can view raw materials and prices.
RawMaterials.name: Name
RawMaterials.approvalsIntro: Check the details and cost, then approve or return with a reason. Nothing changes until you approve.

form.name: Name
form.specificationHint: Only what tells this product apart, e.g. Full cream.
form.priceHint: Leave blank if unknown; the cost will show as incomplete, never as zero. Enter 0 only for free items.
form.coffeeBean: Coffee bean (used in Daily Coffee Calibration)
form.packInvalid: Pack size must be greater than 0
form.priceMissingNote: No price yet: cost will be incomplete.
form.matchesHint: Use the existing material. For a different pack size, open it and add a pack.

detail.notEditable: Submitted and approved materials can't be edited here. Use a price change or a new pack instead.
detail.pendingNote: Packs and prices are approved together with the material.
detail.recipes: {count, plural, =0 {No approved recipes} one {# approved recipe} other {# approved recipes}}

priceChange.notice: This creates a price proposal. The current approved price stays in effect until Admin approves.
priceChange.affected: {count, plural, =0 {No approved recipes use this yet.} one {Affects # approved recipe.} other {Affects # approved recipes.}}

addPack.note: The new pack is sent for approval. The costing pack stays the same.
